task: Force Mode buttons (Speaker/Info/Song/Prayer) to 4 equal columns on mobile so they fit in one row

public/styles/responsive.css.summary: Added .modeGrid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); } inside the existing <=900px block -- the base auto-fit minmax(4.75rem,1fr) only fit 3 columns at typical phone widths, wrapping Prayer to its own row.
